newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Telecom shares surge to year high.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom shares surge to year high.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd shares surged to a year high of HK$16.85 on Tuesday afternoon on renewed rumours parent Cable & Wireless Plc is seeking to place out its stake in the company, brokers said.
"The shares rose on rumours that there is a third party interested in buying part of Cable & Wireless' stake in Hongkong Telecom," a broker said.
The rise could also be related to index futures buying, he said.
Hongkong Telecom shares retreated slightly to HK$16.70, up HK$0.55, in late afternoon trade on volume of 26.48 million shares.
Cable & Wireless holds about 59 percent of Hongkong Telecom.
